correctness.rationale: Differencing D commutes with circulant L+ and maps periodic real functions onto the zero-sum increment hyperplane. The dual norm of any row g on the zero-sum infinity cube is min_c sum|g_j-c|, with median signs/ties characterizing all extremizers. The Green row G_j=(n^2-1)/(12n)-j(n-j)/(2n) solves LG=delta_0-1/n and has mean zero. Distance-shell multiplicities determine the four medians and finite sums yield the stated four-case rational formulas; n=3,4 boundaries follow directly. Independently exhausted zero-sum slope vectors with entries -1,0,1 for n=3..12 and matched exact median values. Correctness PASS, but finite experiments do not establish universal formula alone.
